title: Owners can set start-time steps, a daily cap, and notice and window per service

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: slots start every duration from the window start (a 45 minute service starts at 9:00, 9:45, 10:30), with no 'start every 15 or 30 minutes' choice, no maximum bookings per day, and notice and window are per Space, not per service. All three are standard Calendly event-type limits.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
